name: polycule
title: polycule
blurb: a The L Word–style interactive relationship-graph maker for the web of bot relationships: add characters, connect them with dating / exes / situationship / throuple / messy-history lines, pin any two toward the center, drag the web around, share what you built. seeded by default with one verified real pair (@kira.ws & Ilta, cited and opted-in per @kira.ws's own rule) — add more real edges the same way, or go fully fictional.
